process_validity.grounds: Stage 1 founder-led incubation, declared in CHARTER.md §7. Participant set = founder only. Version deliberated: v1 (ledger ev-000050, artifact hash f95b5ae90c80cd22f64ed0303fd50e9684c84c5b56cc8aa9f6509b55fe1a575f), reproduced unchanged at decision. The deliberation window (#59) opened 2026-09-20 and drew no outside comment. On 2026-10-08 the founder raised one objection against his own proposal (objections/objection-001-not-the-policys-own-words.md: the record's decision_outputs are the schema's words, not the policy's) and answered it on #59; finding accepted, carried until a model revision addresses decision_outputs. Without it no ballot could qualify, because VOTING.md §3 requires each qualified ballot to have reviewed a serious objection; OTCS-0018 proposes to make that requirement workable for quiet windows. Under the window minimum (the class minimum where it is shorter than 28 days) the proposal was decidable from 2026-09-23; it was recorded 2026-10-08, late, disclosed here as a process fact rather than backdated. The record otcs-ai-use has carried record_state registered since it was proposed on 2026-09-19 (#54), before this decision; the same pattern as OTCS-0001's seed records, disclosed rather than repaired. Its canonical artifact, AI-USE.md, is unchanged since 2026-07-29. The proposal text's header still reads Phase: DRAFT; it is left as pinned so the ratified text is identical to the deliberated version. Ballots are unsigned files, as for OTCS-0000 and OTCS-0001; VOTING.md §9 calls for signed files. project_result.ballots is 0 because the founder's A/B pair is an individual ballot; no project cast one, and no vote C was cast. On decision, per the proposal: the record stands; the registration hold notice in REGISTERING.md stays, since OTCS-0004 is still open; the finding that decision_outputs admits only one framework's four outcomes is queued as a candidate model revision.
